answer: Let every identity enter a 14-day probation with a 60-unit refundable bond and a quota of three tasks per epoch. Four unrelated reviewers must approve different outputs before the bond unlocks; two matching fingerprints freeze the account for one full epoch. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and elapsed time. A sybil operator therefore locks 60 units and waits for each alias, while a copied history cannot pass. A vault stores the audit trail, a juniper seed salts each task, and an atlas of peer links exposes coordinated clusters.
